audit_items.proof_trace: The default liquidation path asserts `weighted_debts_value > collateral_weighted_value` (L978-981), directly enforcing the weighted risk >= 1.0 requirement; all three callers of `liquidation_inner` route through this check after interest accrual (L720) and before any state mutations. The ADL override path uses a time-decaying governance-controlled LTV threshold, but requires both an active governance timelock and a breached market-wide limit (`ensure_limit_breached`), making it inaccessible to external attackers.
